site_layout.title: The oblenergo schedule page has changed
site_layout.description: The integration no longer recognises the schedule page on oblenergo.cv.ua and has stopped reading the schedule from it. Until this is fixed, it uses the hours posted in the oblenergo Telegram channel. Please open an issue in the project repository.

telegram_layout.title: The oblenergo Telegram channel has changed
telegram_layout.description: The integration no longer recognises the oblenergo Telegram channel page. The schedule still comes from oblenergo.cv.ua, but the site is now checked every 30 minutes, so changes can take longer to show up. Please open an issue in the project repository.
